content.title: C3 AI weighs sale after founder-CEO Siebel steps aside, sources say
content.summary: (Reuters) ​-Enterprise artificial ‌intelligence software provider ‌C3 AI is exploring a potential sale, among ⁠other ‌options, after founder Thomas ‍Siebel recently stepped down as CEO over ​health concerns,‌ according to three people familiar with the matter.  * Redwood City, California-based C3 provides a platform forcustomers like Shell and the U.S. Air Force to develop andoperate large-scale artificial intelligence applications.  * Its AI tools are used across the U.S. government as wellas the energy and manufacturing sectors, making it a smallerrival to Palantir Technologies.
